name: dna-seq
description: Research-use genomic analysis and annotation capabilities for Claude Code.

plugins.name: ensembl
plugins.description: Query live Ensembl genes, variants, population frequencies, phenotypes, proteins, and GA4GH Refget sequences.

plugins.name: just-prs
plugins.description: Search the PGS Catalog, compute polygenic risk scores, and produce evidence-aware trait interpretations.

plugins.name: just-module-creator
plugins.description: Author, validate, compile, and publish just-dna annotation modules, with schema answers generated from the live just-dna-format models and literature search across PubMed, Europe PMC, Semantic Scholar, OpenAlex, Crossref, and preprints.

plugins.name: just-dna-agents
plugins.description: Research, validate, and compile genetics annotation modules with evidence-aware genomics workflows.

plugins.name: manuscript-skills
plugins.description: Prepare a scientific manuscript for submission: check claims, numbers, references (retractions, and whether a source supports the claim) and figures as printed, simulate referees for the target journal, rank preprint servers and journals by the authors' priorities and AI policies, and edit the prose under a check that no claim got stronger and no number or citation changed. Ends with the corrected version as track changes and an offline dashboard of what the run found.
